api_base.description: Base URL for the Pillar Security API. If not provided, the `PILLAR_API_BASE` environment variable is checked, defaults to https://api.pillar.security

api_key.description: API key for the Pillar Security service. If not provided, the `PILLAR_API_KEY` environment variable is checked.

async_mode.description: Set to True to request asynchronous analysis (sets `plr_async` header).

fallback_on_error.description: Action to take when Pillar API is unavailable or errors: 'allow' (proceed without scanning) or 'block' (reject request with 503 error). If not provided, the `PILLAR_FALLBACK_ON_ERROR` environment variable is checked, defaults to 'allow'.

include_evidence.description: Include detailed evidence objects in response payloads (sets `plr_evidence` header).

include_scanners.description: Include scanner summaries in response payloads (sets `plr_scanners` header).

on_flagged_action.description: Action to take when content is flagged: 'block' (raise exception) or 'monitor' (log only). If not provided, the `PILLAR_ON_FLAGGED_ACTION` environment variable is checked, defaults to 'monitor'.

persist_session.description: Set to False to disable session persistence (sets `plr_persist` header).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for Pillar API calls. If not provided, the `PILLAR_TIMEOUT` environment variable is checked, defaults to 5.0 seconds.
